E01.title: Change one spring: which cells of K change?
E01.lead: Three springs in a chain, a wall on the left, 60 N pulling on the right. Every finite element program ends up solving K u = f. Here you build that K yourself, one spring at a time.

E02.title: The weak form: why we rewrite the heat equation
E02.lead: An aluminum bar, 4 cm long, makes 80 W of heat along its length; both ends are held at 20 °C. A broken line of two straight pieces can't go into its equation. Rewrite the equation, and it can. Here you find the middle temperature yourself, by balancing one hat.
